q: I was told by the boss that it’s not a good idea that I seek out a work restriction from my doctor to limit overtime hours because I ‘signed a contract agreeing to overtime’.
cx: Nearly 14 weeks, sick, in a new desk role with 55–70 hour weeks.

q: We only get 3 paid sick days. And 3 unpaid. I’ve used up 3 days due to being severely sick and not being able to pull through 11-12 hour shifts.
cx: Sick days used up by early-pregnancy sickness.

q: I tried to set a boundary saying I was only able to stay until 4:30-5:00 each day, but I was told if I’d leave at those times it’d be insubordination. That’s 9.5-10 hours a day I offered, and it wasn’t enough.
cx: Her offer to shorten her days was refused.

q: I’m afraid they’ll say it’ll cause undue hardship to the company if I say I can only work 40-45 hours a week. I don’t want to lose my job
cx: Afraid to hand HR a doctor's work restriction.

q: I’m barely getting through this. I want to just walk out every day. The fact that I was advised not to get a medical accommodation literally made me feel so defeated and trapped.
cx: How the boss's warning landed.

q: My anxiety is constantly through the roof.
cx: Long workdays with no end time.

q: I’m feeling quite conflicted and upset about how I have been made to feel like a silly first time mum for raising my concerns about his size, and I feel like had I not been lucky enough to have a friend with connections this would have been missed.
cx: UK, 31 weeks; a growth scan came only through a friend's contact.

q: All I wanted was to be given as much info as possible really to make choices with, and now because they’ve left it so late it all feels like a bit of a rush.
cx: What she wanted from her midwives.

q: A&E doctor (a man) told me I was just “very young and didn’t know what pregnancy felt like” - I’m 30, married etc. was made to feel like a silly teen girl
cx: Sent to A&E by triage weeks earlier.

q: It genuinely does feel like they’re annoyed you’re there/asking questions most of the time.
cx: Her sense of UK maternity staff.

q: it’s so weird how all the trusts have different rules!
cx: Comparing her NHS trust's rules with another commenter's.

q: I have watched 100s of videos of women talking about their experience with symptoms in pregnancy and read tons of online forums about pregnancy symptoms, not once did I hear or see anybody talk about pregnancy related carpal tunnel syndrome!!!
cx: A hand symptom from 30 weeks that no content prepared her for.

q: It is now so extreme that it is affecting my motor function with my hands and I can't properly do many tasks.
cx: Hand numbness and pain getting worse.

q: Has anyone used or come across a cute way to share registry information other than a birth announcement?
cx: No shower, family a plane ride away; teacher budget makes gifts matter.

q: I have already made some registries for this reason but also the completion discounts and keeping track of supplies.
cx: Why she made registries even without a shower.

q: I don't really want to deal with a bunch of boxes plus having to set up/wash a bunch of things after the baby is here.
cx: Why she doesn't want gifts arriving after the birth.

q: when I tell people how far along I am they say shit like 'wow you're so big!!' and 'are you sure it's just one in there?' and it just drives me insane.
cx: At 28 weeks, after gaining 15 kg.

q: In the city I'm in, as well as my social media feed all I see is these tiny perfect pregnant girls
cx: What she compares herself to.

q: I feel incredibly guilty that I'm failing my baby before he's even here... by not eating the right foods, by gaining weight so rapidly.
cx: Guilt about food and weight in the third trimester.

q: Please someone tell me I'm not alone in this? It would already help a little to know or talk to anyone going through the same.
cx: What would help.

q: I think because theyve gone through all the potential risks of a large baby, its just thrown me off a bit.
cx: 38-week scan estimate, induction suggested at 39 weeks.

q: every health care person ive spoke to so far, has said they wouldn't want me going past my due date.
cx: After a scan estimate in her second pregnancy.

q: I find I’m getting overwhelmed quickly when I think about it all in one bucket.
cx: At six weeks: car, nursery space, cats, all at once.

q: I have an older car and he has an older car that both run great but should we be getting a new car? Is a payment something we should be adding on right now?
cx: First questions at six weeks.
